lines.trans: Twelve Singers is number one on the trending chart, and countless netizens are sharing posts on their own!
After watching the broadcast, local residents voluntarily opened their own homes so stranded people could shelter from the rain.

words.gram: Meaning: take shelter from the rain.

lines.trans: We pulled it off! We really pulled it off!
So this book was with you all along—I thought it had gotten lost in the chaos that day.
It was not lost—I kept it safe right here.
Let me tell you, this broadcast achieved astonishing ratings, helped so many people, and won universal praise everywhere!
Did the doctor give you a full check-up? What did he say?
Nothing serious.
I took annual leave so I can look after you these next few days, assuming you do not find me annoying.
Have you not been taking care of me this whole time?
Let me go pour you a cup of water.
